scope: mkosi.images/himmelblau activation (first live sideload on a snow install)
correction: Three things the fixture tests and a Trixie container could not show. (1) himmelblaud 4.0.2 does NOT tolerate a missing domain: it spends ~13 s on HSM init and then exits 1 with 'No provider was configured!', so a 7 s liveness probe was a false positive and the daemon restart-looped under Upholds= on the unconfigured machine. (2) Condition-gating a unit that is under Upholds= is not a fix: systemd retries an upheld unit whose condition fails continuously (33 'skipped, unmet condition' starts in 12 s, then 'not starting since we tried this too often recently. Will retry later'). Uphold a RemainAfterExit oneshot and have IT Wants= the gated daemon instead. (3) A unit ordered Before=ssh.service must not issue a blocking `systemctl try-reload-or-restart ssh.service` from its ExecStart: the reload job queues behind the unit's own start job and a oneshot has no default start timeout, so the unit hung indefinitely. Use --no-block. Also relearned: never run a global `systemd-tmpfiles --create` on this workstation -- an existing rule walks a CIFS share under /var/home/bjk/archive and blocks in D state for minutes (this is also why its boots are slow; separate follow-up).
evidence: journalctl -u himmelblaud on the snow host 2026-09-09: 'No domains configured in himmelblau.conf.' / 'No provider was configured!' / 'Consumed 12.914s CPU time over 13.586s wall clock' / 'Scheduled restart job immediately on client request'. Probe units snosi-cond-probe.service (ConditionPathExists=/nonexistent) upheld by snosi-cond-upholder.target under /run/systemd/system: journalctl counted 33 condition-skip lines plus 2 'Will retry later' lines in 12 s. ps showed `systemctl try-reload-or-restart ssh.service` (child of himmelblau-sysext-setup, PID 102014) sleeping 2 min with the setup unit's start job still pending; killing it let the unit finish. /proc/<tmpfiles pid>/stack: cifs_readdir under getdents64 with fds open on /var/home/bjk/archive/agent-graveyard.
